subject: Post-call: POC charter & model roster for LexiComp trial
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Ana Garcia <ana.garcia@lexicomp.com>
Cc: security@lexicomp.com, procurement@lexicomp.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: POC charter & model roster for LexiComp trial

Hi Ana (and LexiComp team),

Thanks again for the call today — great context on the search/retrieval + attribute extraction use case and the multilingual volume you expect. High level recap and proposed next steps below so we can get the POC scoped and scheduled: please confirm or flag edits.

Recap (short)
- Goal: Replace current rule-based extraction for drug metadata with an LLM-powered pipeline that handles English + Spanish clinical notes and preserves auditability.
- Primary success criteria: extraction precision >= 92% (slot-level), recall >= 88% on the evaluation set; latency P95 per request < 350ms; no PHI exfiltration; deployment in customer VPC for data-in-rest.

POC scope & timeline (proposed)
- Week 0 (this week): finalize POC charter and sign NDAs/POC MSA.
- Week 1: data ingestion & mapping (sample dataset: 5k anonymized rows you provide).
- Week 2–3: model runs, evaluation, and tuning (two model variants: primary + fallback).
- Week 4: joint review and decision / ramp plan.

Model roster suggestion (initial)
- Primary: Mistral-Instruct-7B (good instruction-following, fast on 1–2 GPU config)
- Fallback: Llama-2-13B-chat (quantized variant for cost-controlled baseline)
- Preprocessing: bilingual token normalization + unicode NFC; for Spanish-heavy docs we propose a small translate-to-en step for intent classification experiments, but keep extraction tests bilingual to measure real-world performance.

Owners
- Redwood: Jonas Weber (sales, engagement owner) + Solutions lead (assign once charter signed).
- LexiComp: Ana (product), Security contact (cc), Procurement (cc).

Attachments
- Attached: lexicomp-poc-requirements.xlsx (worksheet with fields + sample rows), redwood-poc-charter-v1.pdf (template).

Asks / next steps for LexiComp
1) Confirm that the success criteria above look reasonable.
2) Share the anonymized sample dataset (S3 link or Drive) and a contact for API/IP allowlist for VPC work.
3) Confirm procurement timeline (procurement@lexicomp.com cc).
4) Do you need an NDA before we share the trial access details?

I'll loop Solutions & Eng once we have confirmation; happy to schedule a 30-min kickoff to walk the team through data needs.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0112

From: Ana Garcia <ana.garcia@lexicomp.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: security@lexicomp.com, procurement@lexicomp.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: POC charter & model roster for LexiComp trial

Hi Jonas — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Success criteria: the extraction precision/recall targets look in line with our expectations. We also want a secondary metric: semantic integrity score for rewrite/normalization tasks (we typically look for >0.86 cosine on our embeddings baseline).
2) Latency: 350ms P95 is OK as long as P50 is under 120ms for short requests — the UI team will test perceived snappiness.
3) Multilingual: Spanish coverage is mandatory. We will provide ~3k Spanish rows and ~2k English rows for the initial run (anonymized). Spanish contains many colloquial abbreviations; share any recommended tokenization or normalization steps.
4) Security/procurement: security@lexicomp.com will send a short questionnaire; we generally require SOC2 evidence or equivalent. Procurement requested an estimated cost range for a 4-week POC (rough).

We are fine with an NDA to proceed. Please include a one-page data handling note.

Thanks — Ana
Ana Garcia
Director, Product — LexiComp

Subject: Re: Post-call: POC charter & model roster for LexiComp trial

Thanks Jonas and Ana — looping in Priyom to lead the POC delivery. Below are concrete recommendations from Solutions/Applied ML to make the eval efficient and reduce iteration friction. I attached a short eval checklist (redwood-eval-checklist.md).

Technical proposal (concise)
- Data: agree to a 5k-row anonymized set. Request: include 200 labeled ground-truth rows for quick smoke validation and a 500-row holdout for final scoring.
- Models to test (exact names we will instantiate)
  * Primary (fast, small footprint): mistral-instruct-7b-v1 (FP16 runtime; best-effort for instruction extraction)
  * Secondary/fallback (robust multilingual & few-shot): llama-2-13b-chat-q4 (4-bit quantized)
  * Canary (if we need higher quality): falcon-40b-instruct (only if the first two fail quality tests; longer latency/cost).
- Strategy: run bilingual extraction tests (evaluate on original Spanish + English) and a translated pipeline (translate-to-en -> run extraction -> map back) as an experiment. Use bilingual evaluation as the gating criteria.

Evaluation plan & metrics
- Slot extraction: precision, recall, F1 at field level. Target: precision >= 92%, recall >= 88%.
- Normalization/rewrites: semantic similarity (cosine) vs human-normalized strings; target >= 0.86.
- Latency: request-level P95 < 350ms on our 1-GPU test harness; P50 < 120ms. If P95 too high, evaluate batching trade-offs.
- Cost sensitivity: include tokenized cost estimates for each model variant (we'll provide a simple cost sheet).

Ownership & timeline
- Redwood delivery lead: Priyom Das (priyom_das@redwood.com) — primary contact for data ingestion, evaluation runs, and dashboard setup.
- Redwood engineering support: Marissa Cole — will coordinate the trial infra and runbooks.
- LexiComp: Ana Garcia (product), security@lexicomp.com, procurement@lexicomp.com.
- Timeline: Kickoff next Tue 2027-04-27, data ingest 1–2 days, first model runs by 2027-05-03, joint review 2027-05-10.

Temporary access & security notes
- We will provide a sandbox API key and a short-lived VPC peering template; please confirm if LexiComp wants a VPC or S3-based pull flow.
- Security: Priyom will send our SOC2 snapshot + one-pager on data handling.

Attachments included
- redwood-eval-checklist.md (attached)

Priyom — please confirm resource availability for the 04/27 kickoff and if we need to reserve additional GPU slots.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
